name: Ginger-garlic paste
storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard. After opening: fridge, tightly sealed, use a clean dry spoon — 1–3 months. Freeze in small portions for longer storage.
looksLike: Thick, pale beige to light-brown paste, slightly grainy, with a sharp ginger-garlic smell; sold in pouches, jars or tubs.
howToPick: check the manufacture date (fresher is more pungent); paste should be beige, not dark brown or grey; avoid puffed pouches or a fermented/sour smell. "No added colour" variants cost more.
shelfLife: unopened about 9–12 months (Smith & Jones lists 360 days); after opening, 1–3 months in the fridge (follow the pack).
mergeNotes: Range 175.0–245.0 was wider than 30% of avg 215.0; narrowed to ±15%.
